# unchanged. See `claude-notes/plans/2026-04-24-websites-phase-5.md`
# Decision 10.

# To re-capture (if intentional changes to default theme / template
# land), render `doc.qmd` and run:
#   shasum -a 256 doc.html doc_files/styles.css

# with Q1 (no SCSS rule selects on it; it's a defensive addition that
# anchors the website-sidebar layout fix in template.rs).
#
# Re-captured 2026-04-30 (bd-bsut): doc_files/styles.css hash updated
# because the page-nav layout SCSS (`.page-navigation { display: flex; …
# }`, `.nav-page` family, `@media print { .nav-page { display: none } }`)
# was ported from Q1 into `_bootstrap-rules.scss`. doc.html hash is
# unchanged: the new selectors don't match anything in a single-doc
# render's body, and `<head>` is unaffected (no <link> changes for
# single-doc).
#
# Re-captured 2026-04-30 (bd-bsut, sidebar-link parity follow-up):
# doc_files/styles.css hash updated again because the sidebar-link
# styling SCSS (`.sidebar-navigation a { color: inherit }`,
# `.sidebar-title > a`, `.sidebar-item`, `.sidebar-section`,
# `div.sidebar-item-container { color/hover/active/disabled }`, …) was
# ported from Q1 into `_bootstrap-rules.scss` next to the page-nav
# block. doc.html hash unchanged for the same reason as before — none
# of the `.sidebar-*` selectors match anything in a single-doc body.
#
# Re-captured 2026-04-30 (bd-bsut, .sidebar-title font-sizing): added
# the missing `.sidebar-title { font-size: 1.3rem; line-height: 1.6rem;
# … }` rule from Q1's `quarto-nav.scss:281` so the website's site-title
# at the top of the sidebar reads as a heading instead of inheriting
# the small sidebar-link font-size.
#
# Re-captured 2026-04-30 (bd-k8y0, sidebar appearance polish): added
# `.quarto-container { min-height: calc(100vh - 132px) }` (so a docked
# sidebar's vertical separator extends to the bottom of the viewport
# on short pages) and `#quarto-sidebar > * { padding-right: 1em }` (so
# toggle dongles aren't flush against the sidebar's right border).
# Both ported from Q1's `quarto-nav.scss` (lines 53-55 and 623-628).
# doc.html hash unchanged: neither selector matches anything in a
# single-doc body (no `.quarto-container` and no `#quarto-sidebar`),
# but they appear in the compiled CSS so the `styles.css` hash shifts.
#
# Re-captured 2026-05-01 (bd-f5yi follow-up, c8dcbcf6): added
# `body.floating .sidebar.sidebar-navigation { display: none }` under
# `media-breakpoint-down(lg)` so a floating sidebar disappears in the
# 768–991 px range instead of collapsing to a 26-px ghost column.
# doc.html hash unchanged: the new selector doesn't match anything in
# a single-doc body (no `body.floating`), but it appears in the
# compiled CSS so the `styles.css` hash shifts.

# do not list it here because the baseline only tracks files that

# Re-captured 2026-05-19 (bd-j1trh, Commit 3): both hashes updated.
# doc.html shifts because ClipboardJsStage now also ships
# `js:code-copy-init` (a small init handler), adding a third
# `<script src="doc_files/code-copy-init.js"></script>` tag in

# positioned button anchor to the scaffold instead of the viewport
# (caught during browser e2e). The new selectors don't match
# anything in the single-doc fixture's body (no code blocks), but
# they appear in the compiled CSS so the hash shifts. A new file
# `doc_files/code-copy-init.js` is also written; not listed here
# per the same convention as `bootstrap.bundle.min.js` /
# `clipboard.min.js`.

# Re-captured 2026-05-20 (bd-mtzry): doc.html hash updated because the
# default body class now appends `quarto-light` so theme-conditional
# CSS keys off `body.quarto-light` (matches Q1's default body class).
# `<body class="fullcontent">` → `<body class="fullcontent quarto-light">`.
# doc_files/styles.css hash unchanged: this is a template-only change.
#
# Re-captured 2026-06-03 (bd-jby1i): doc_files/styles.css hash updated
# because `highlight.scss` gained the two margin rules Q1 inherits
# from Pandoc's baseline highlighting CSS:
# `div.sourceCode { margin: 1em 0 }` and `pre.sourceCode { margin: 0 }`.
# Without them, Bootstrap reboot's `pre { margin-bottom: 1rem }` was
# trapped inside the BFC created by `div.sourceCode { overflow-y:
# hidden }` and rendered as a stray empty line at the bottom of every
# highlighted code block. doc.html hash unchanged: the fixture has no
# code blocks, and the change is CSS-only.
#
# Re-captured 2026-06-10 (bd-15uump3h): doc_files/styles.css hash updated
# because a new built-in SCSS layer `embed-example.scss` ships default
# styling for the `.embed-example-iframe` transform's "Demo N" blocks
# (bordered frame + muted caption: `.embed-example`,
# `.embed-example iframe.embed-example-iframe { border: 3px solid
# $gray-300 }`, `.embed-example-source`, `.embed-example-label`). Like
# the highlight layer, it's always included so the feature has a sensible
# default appearance with no per-project CSS. doc.html hash unchanged:
# the fixture has no `.embed-example-iframe` div, so the new selectors
# match nothing in the body/head — they only appear in the compiled CSS,
# so the `styles.css` hash shifts.
# Re-captured 2026-06-13 (bd-yomgkxoc): the test now NORMALIZES the
# embedded generator version (`quarto-rust-X.Y.Z` -> `quarto-rust-VERSION`)
# before hashing `doc.html`, so the baseline is stable across workspace
# version bumps (we bump on a cadence now). The doc.html hash below is
# therefore of the version-normalized bytes, not the raw file. styles.css
# carries no version and is hashed raw (unchanged). To re-capture after an
# *intentional* render change, run the test and copy the `left:` hash from
# the failure -- do NOT shasum the raw doc.html, the version won't match.
#
# Re-captured 2026-06-23 (bd-lg6t6qfy): doc_files/styles.css hash updated
# because the copy-button SCSS rules (`$code-copy-selector`,
# `$btn-code-copy-color*`, `.code-copy-outer-scaffold`, `.code-copy-button`,
# the `.bi::before` SVG-icon states — the block the 2026-05-19 bd-j1trh
# entry added) were EXTRACTED out of `_bootstrap-rules.scss` into a shared,
# self-contained `copy-code.scss` layer (`load_copy_code_layer`) so the
# revealjs path can bundle the same rules. The rules are byte-for-byte the
# same (the lone `$gray-900` -> literal `#212529` swap is a never-taken
# fallback branch in HTML); only their POSITION in the minified CSS changed
# (now emitted in the user-layer slot, after Bootstrap+Quarto, like the
# highlight layer). Verified the only delta is rule ordering: splitting both
# styles.css on `}` and sorting yields identical output (same 317278 bytes).
# doc.html hash unchanged: HTML body/head are byte-identical (the fixture has
# no code block).

# doc_files/styles.css hash updated because the base
# `#title-block-header { margin-block-end: 1rem; position: relative;
# margin-top: -1px }` rule from TS Quarto's `_quarto-rules.scss` was
# ported into `resources/scss/html/templates/title-block.scss`. Q2 had
# only the `body.nav-sidebar` responsive override (`…margin-block-end: 0`)
# and no base rule, so the title block sat flush against the first article
# section (Q1 renders a 1rem/17px gap). doc.html hash unchanged: the change
# is CSS-only and the fixture's `#title-block-header` element already
# existed — only the compiled CSS gained the rule, so the `styles.css`
# hash shifts.
# Re-captured 2026-07-21 (bd-iq08mmnh, title-block remainder parity):
# doc_files/styles.css hash updated because the two unconditional
# title-block rules from TS Quarto's `_quarto-rules.scss:193-201` —
# `#title-block-header a { text-decoration: none }` and the grouped
# `#title-block-header .author,.date,.doi { margin-block-end: 0.2rem }` —

# Re-captured 2026-07-21 (bd-dxgcpl02, tables base parity):
# doc_files/styles.css hash updated because three table rules from TS Quarto's
# `_quarto-rules.scss:226-241` — `tr.header > th > p:last-of-type { margin-bottom:
# 0px }`, `table,table.table { margin-top/bottom: 0.5rem }`, and `caption {
# padding-top/bottom: 0.5rem; text-align: center }` — were ported into
# `_bootstrap-rules.scss`. All three match live Q2 DOM (`<table class="table">`,
# `<th><p>` in multi-block header cells, `<caption>` in plain-caption tables); the
# caption `text-align:center` overrides bootstrap core's bare `caption{text-align:
# left}` via source order. `.table-caption` was NOT ported (no such class emitted).
# doc.html hash unchanged: CSS-only change (the fixture's table markup pre-existed).
# Re-captured 2026-07-21 (bd-u5yvsdgw, code CSS parity):
# doc_files/styles.css hash updated because four code rules from TS Quarto's
# `_quarto-rules.scss` were ported: bare `code{white-space:pre}` + its
# `@media print{code{white-space:pre-wrap}}` override (L299-306) into
# highlight.scss; `p/dd code:not(.sourceCode){white-space:pre-wrap}` (L291-294,
# extending Q2's existing `td` variant) and `.callout pre.sourceCode{padding-
# left:0}` (L442-444) into _bootstrap-rules.scss. All verified against live DOM.
# NOT ported (documented in the strand): 13d `$code-white-space` var (theming
# infra, no visible gap), 13e line-anchor `::before` (reclassified BLOCKED — Q2
# emits no `<span><a>` line-number anchors), 13g `code a:any-link` (Q2 already
# ships a divergent downlit rule — pending a design call). doc.html hash
# unchanged: CSS-only change (the fixture's code markup pre-existed).
